name: forecastquery
description: Provides APIs for creating and managing Amazon Forecast resources

subcommands.name: query-forecast
subcommands.description: Retrieves a forecast for a single item, filtered by the supplied criteria. The criteria is a key-value pair.

options.name: --forecast-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the forecast to query

options.name: --start-date
options.description: The start date for the forecast. Specify the date using this format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss (ISO 8601 format). For example, 2015-01-01T08:00:00

options.name: --end-date
options.description: The end date for the forecast. Specify the date using this format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss (ISO 8601 format). For example, 2015-01-01T20:00:00

options.name: --filters
options.description: The filtering criteria to apply when retrieving the forecast.

options.name: --next-token
options.description: If the result of the previous request was truncated, the response includes a NextToken. To retrieve the next set of results, use the token in the next request.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
